title: AEC official tests the device on himself
summary: Greg Malatzi tells of AEC official tests the device on himself, about 1962-1963 at Intelectron, New York City, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: one of the guys is like, "I don't believe you, you know, test me." And just and and and did the test on himself and it worked.

plain: A researcher named Greg Malatzi, drawing on letters from the Atomic Energy Commission, the US agency that oversaw nuclear matters, and the work of the writer Annie Jacobsen, describes a device being shown at Intelectron, a company in New York City, around 1962 and 1963. He says one official did not believe the device worked, asked to be tested, tried it on himself, and it worked.
